_notes: Canonical MCP server config for au-gov-data. Edit only this file. Run scripts/render-mcp.py to regenerate .mcp.json / .gemini/settings.json / .codex/config.toml / .vscode/mcp.json.
_connection_model: No-auth HTTP MCPs (stromy-format) and stdio servers reach every target. An authenticated HTTP MCP (interactive OAuth, e.g. toolkit, asset-broker) is declared only as a bundled Claude connector (`_connector: true`, `_consumed_by: ["claude"]`, its catalog hosted_url, no headers): Claude lists it on the plugin's Connectors tab and the user signs in once with Connect, through Claude's hosted OAuth callback, so it works in Cowork too. See infra-docs/ai/mcp-connection-model.md (enforced by validate-plugin-completeness.py Invariant #13).
